newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Bre-X won't hit investor confidence, minister says.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X won't hit investor confidence, minister says.

text.p: The Bre-X mining incident will not shatter investor confidence in the Toronto Stock Exchange, Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin said on Friday.
"I don't think there will be any effect. This is an incident, incidents occur," he told Reuters Financial Television when asked whether investor confidence would be affected.
Bre-X shares fell sharply after questions arose over its claims of a massive gold discovery in Indonesia.
"It's now being looked at by the equity regulators. (We) have very strong, very confident regulation in Canada," Martin said.
He is in the Philippines to attend a meeting of Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation forum finance ministers.
